description: This Java class is an implementation of a builder for creating responses and events related to a 'DeleteFeature' live command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles creating command responses for successful deletion and error scenarios, as well as generating event objects when a feature is deleted.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing the builder pattern for creating command responses and events related to deleting a feature in a live command context. It extends an abstract base class and implements the 'DeleteFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder' interface. Contains internal classes for response and event factory implementations.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new builder instance for a given DeleteFeatureLiveCommand.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a command response by applying the provided response factory function.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates an event by applying the provided event factory function.
